title: Open Science, Education & Creative Tools
description: Free curated resources for open science, education, and creative work. Useful for humans and AI agents.

items.name: arXiv
items.description: Open-access preprints in physics, math, CS, quantitative biology and more.

items.name: PubMed Central
items.description: Free full-text archive of biomedical and life sciences literature.

items.name: Zenodo
items.description: CERN-backed repository for research data, software and publications with DOIs.

items.name: Open Science Framework
items.description: Open project management, data sharing and preregistration platform.

items.name: DOAJ
items.description: Directory of Open Access Journals – high-quality peer-reviewed OA journals.

items.name: Internet Archive
items.description: Books, journals, software, web history (Wayback Machine) and more.

items.name: Unpaywall
items.description: Finds legal open-access versions of research papers.

items.name: Wikimedia Commons
items.description: Free media files under open licenses.

items.name: MIT OpenCourseWare
items.description: Almost the entire MIT curriculum free for the world.

items.name: Khan Academy
items.description: Free world-class education with personalized practice.

items.name: OpenStax
items.description: Peer-reviewed openly licensed college textbooks.

items.name: PhET Interactive Simulations
items.description: Free research-based science and math simulations.

items.name: LibreTexts
items.description: Open textbooks and educational resources across many fields.

items.name: Project Gutenberg
items.description: 70,000+ free public-domain eBooks.

items.name: Scratch
items.description: MIT creative coding platform for learning programming by making.

items.name: Coursera (Audit)
items.description: Many university courses can be audited for free.

items.name: Photopea
items.description: Full Photoshop-like editor that runs in the browser.

items.name: Excalidraw
items.description: Open-source virtual whiteboard with hand-drawn feel.

items.name: p5.js Web Editor
items.description: Creative coding environment for interactive art and generative design.

items.name: CodePen
items.description: Front-end playground for HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

items.name: Figma (Free)
items.description: Collaborative interface design tool with a strong free plan.

items.name: Tinkercad
items.description: Free browser-based 3D design and electronics simulation.

items.name: Radio Garden
items.description: Listen to live radio stations from anywhere on Earth.

items.name: Canva (Free)
items.description: Easy graphic design with a generous free tier.
